title: 3D signs, logos, and illuminated advertising | Elektro Drapač

blocks.text: Production of illuminated signage with top-quality craftsmanship and custom design tailored to your needs.
Explore a diverse range of profiles with different characteristics and technical solutions. Remember, everything can be adjusted:
For indoor and outdoor settings where illuminated advertising is not needed to attract attention.
For indoor and outdoor use. Soft, indirect backlighting creates an elegant, understated effect.
Durable signage for exposed, windy locations at height. It attracts attention from a distance and offers a long service life even in adverse conditions.
For indoor and outdoor use. The most popular type of illuminated 3D signage, with an illuminated face.
3D signs with illuminated face and sides
For indoor and outdoor use. Both the face and sides of the letters can be illuminated.
For indoor and outdoor use. Ideal for small signs and lettering with shapes that are difficult to form.
From classic non-illuminated signs to modern LED options. We offer solutions that fit perfectly into your concept.

From the first sketch to final installation. Choose from a wide variety of materials, colours, and lighting options. Before production, we prepare a 3D visualisation so you can see exactly what the final product will look like.

Our illuminated signs are built to withstand all weather conditions and come with up to a 5-year warranty. High-quality materials with surface treatments ensure colour and appearance stability for many years.
Lower production and maintenance costs compared to illuminated versions. Unlimited width and thickness.
Graphics: Unlimited colour options thanks to translucent film

Body: A wide range of materials, including aluminium, acrylic glass, sheet materials, polystyrene and cardboard, with optional 3D printing for lighter components and exceptional precision, plus paint finishes to suit individual requirements
Placement: On facades, roofs, parapets, ground-mounted, ceiling-hung, on wood, on glass
Elegant. Subtle. Option to combine front and back lighting.
Graphics: Unlimited colour options thanks to translucent film
Body: Aluminium, acrylic glass, sheet materials, optional use of 3D printing (lighter, surgically precise)
Placement: On facades, roofs, parapets, ground-mounted, ceiling-hung, on wood (or other background for an aura effect)
Robust, weather-resistant signage. A fixing rail integrated into the side of the letter secures the flexible face material. Unlimited size, lighting colour and body colour options.
Graphics: Unlimited colour options thanks to translucent film and paint finishes
Body: Aluminium, acrylic glass, sheet materials, optional use of 3D printing (lighter, surgically precise)
Placement: On façades, roofs, parapets, the ground or wood, suspended from ceilings, and in other locations to suit the customer’s needs
The most popular choice for 3D signage. A striking sign offering excellent value for money. Up to 2 metres high, with no visible frame around the face.
Graphics: Unlimited options of acrylic glass colours and translucent film
Body: Aluminium, acrylic glass, sheet materials, optional use of 3D printing (lighter, surgically precise)
Placement: On façades, roofs, parapets, the ground or wood, or suspended from ceilings. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.
3D signs with illuminated face and sides
Face and sides are illuminated, ensuring visibility from different angles. The most impressive and vibrant sign option.
Graphics: Unlimited options through translucent film combined with coloured acrylic glass and LEDs
Placement: On façades, roofs, parapets, the ground, wood and shopfronts, suspended from ceilings, or in interior spaces
Ideal for small or intricately shaped signs. Face and sides can be illuminated. Affordable neon-like look with minimal energy consumption.
Graphics: Unlimited options through translucent film, paint finishes and LED colours
Placement: Primarily for indoor use, on office walls and in corridors, reception areas and entrance halls
